About the artist

Hi, I'm Nour.

I've been painting with acrylics for as long as I can remember — starting with scraps of cardboard and kitchen-table still lifes, and growing into a small practice I now share with the world. Nour's Art Book is my open sketchbook: a place to show finished canvases, works still drying, and the odd happy accident.

I'm drawn to warm palettes, everyday moments, and textures you want to reach out and touch. Every piece starts on real canvas, mixed and layered by hand — no shortcuts, no filters.
